description: Defines synchronization primitives and stop event mechanisms using futexes and busy waiting policies, including classes for stop event source and tokens with thread-safe stop signaling and observer management.

classes.name: futex_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy using Linux futexes for thread synchronization.

classes.name: busy_wait_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy using busy waiting with sleep intervals to avoid OS primitives.

classes.name: stop_event_source_impl
classes.description: Template class managing stop signals and observer tokens with thread-safe state.

classes.name: stop_event_token_impl
classes.description: Observer class representing a token for stop events, managing reference counting and stop status.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Creates a new observer token for the stop event source.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests all observers to stop and waits until they are reset.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stop request, allowing new stop signals.

methods.name: nof_tokens_approx
methods.description: Returns an approximate count of active observer tokens.

methods.name: is_stop_requested
methods.description: Checks if a stop has been requested.
